channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ato da direita reúne dezenas na Paulista com louvores e parabéns a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A conservative Christian right-wing rally gathered approximately sixty people on Paulista Avenue on May 1, 2026, to support former President Jair Bolsonaro and the presidential candidacy of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, featuring calls for amnesty related to the January 8 events, criticism of the Supreme Court and Lula’s government, and a celebration of Flávio Bolsonaro’s 45th birthday. The event displayed symbols such as the Gadsden flag, costumes of 'Uncle Sam' and a giant Bolsonaro head, and included ultrarreligious declarations, including denunciations of alleged pedophile networks linked to Epstein Island.

item.title: Flávio diz que trabalhador sustenta vida de luxo de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential pre-candidate, claims Brazilian workers finance President Lula’s luxurious lifestyle using public funds, citing over R$1.4 billion spent on corporate cards for luxury hotels, food, and wines abroad. He argues that taxpayer money is being misused to sustain a life of luxury for someone who claims to be the 'father of the poor.' Bolsonaro states he will not make empty promises but instead commit to workers to build a Brazil of prosperity and opportunity.

item.title: Lula deve deixar para Alcolumbre promulgação de dosimetria
item.description: President Lula will not promulgate the Dosimetry Bill after Congress overturned his veto; the duty will fall to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The bill benefits Bolsonaro and 849 others convicted of the January 8 attacks, potentially reducing Bolsonaro’s sentence by 6 years and 7 months, pending STF confirmation. The PT plans to challenge the measure in court after promulgation, arguing the integral veto was unconstitutionally 'split' by Congress.

item.title: Messias agradece apoio de Jaques Wagner após derrota no Senado
item.description: Union Attorney General Jorge Messias thanked Senate Government Leader Jaques Wagner and Senator Otto Alencar after his Supreme Court nomination was rejected by the Senate plenary, receiving 34 favorable votes, 42 against, and 1 abstention. The defeat marks the first time since 1894 that the Senate has blocked a presidential nomination to the STF, dealing a significant blow to Lula’s government. Messias expressed gratitude for the support received and invoked faith and thankfulness in his public statement.

item.title: YouTube derruba novo canal de Monark 5 dias após retorno
item.description: YouTube removed Monark’s new channel, 'Bruno Aiub Show', five days after his social media return, citing community guideline violations, though his defense claims no political content was posted and prior court orders were revoked in February 2025. The defense filed an internal administrative appeal, while a Federal Police report was sent to the STF alleging Monark continued attacks on Brazil’s electoral system and Supreme Court ministers, part of an inquiry into potential judicial disobedience. Additionally, the São Paulo Public Prosecutor’s Office has reversed its stance and now seeks a R$ 4 million indemnity for Monark’s 2022 remarks on Nazism.

item.title: “Lula usa tragédia em Recife para fazer pré-campanha”
item.description: President Lula was criticized by federal deputy Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) for allegedly exploiting the tragic heavy rains in Recife as a political opportunity, after meeting with former mayor João Campos (PSB) and Senator Humberto Costa (PT) to coordinate federal actions in the metropolitan region.

item.title: Esquerda reúne 300 pessoas no Centro de São Paulo
item.description: Left-wing May Day events in São Paulo in 2026 drew approximately 300 people to Roosevelt Square and 400 to the Metalworkers' Union in Liberdade, demanding an end to the 6x1 work shift. The demonstrations were moved from Paulista Avenue after it was reserved by the right-wing group Patriotas do QG, whose own rally attracted only 95 attendees. Federal Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol) criticized the absence of unions on the avenue, alleging Governor Tarcísio de Freitas sought to block workers' demonstrations.

item.title: Campeã do “BBB 26” defende fim da escala 6 X 1 em vídeo
item.description: Journalist and BBB 26 winner Ana Paula Renault criticized in a Workers' Day video the Congress' overturning of Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, stating it 'tampers with democracy itself'. She advocated for ending the 6x1 work scale and adopting a 5x2 schedule, accusing legislators of prioritizing big business interests over workers' well-being, leaving social reforms stalled while measures benefiting few advance quickly.

item.title: Senador vê ‘recado’ para Lula e aponta ‘único nome’ que Senado aprovaria hoje
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF) states that the historic rejection of Jorge Messias' Supreme Court nomination by the Senate was an 'institutional message' to the Lula government and the Judiciary, resulting from opposition coordination and accumulated discontent with Court interference. He notes that PL, Novo, and Avante united against the nomination, with support from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, and sees the episode as a step toward political recomposure despite existing tensions.

item.title: Messias agradece senadores aliados, após críticas de atuação da base e acusações de traições em derrota ao STF
item.description: The head of the AGU, Jorge Messias, thanked senators Otto Alencar and Jaques Wagner for their unconditional support after his Supreme Court nomination was rejected by the Senate. The defeat, by a vote of 42 to 34, was blamed by government allies on betrayals from members of the MDB, PP, and PSD parties, as well as coordination led by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who denies acting against him. Messias suggested he may resign from his position at the AGU following the defeat.

item.title: Lula determina apoio federal após fortes chuvas em Recife
item.description: President Lula announced federal government support for the Recife metropolitan area following heavy rains that triggered landslides and left at least four people missing. Since Friday, April 30, over 100 millimeters of rain have been recorded in the region, according to state Civil Defense. The federal response aims to assist in rescue operations, aid victims, and support recovery in affected areas.

item.title: Janones sugere que Lula deixe cargo "até o fim do mês" e percorra país
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Avante-MG) suggested that President Lula step down from office until the end of the month to travel across Brazil leading a national campaign to end the 6x1 work schedule. Janones argued this agenda could unite the country and represent the biggest workers' victory since the CLT, but lamented that the left is missing opportunities by repeating conspiracy narratives, as seen in the rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination.

item.title: 1º de Maio: com baixa adesão, ato da direita na Paulista tem tumultos
item.description: A right-wing rally on May 1st in Paulista Avenue, São Paulo, drew low attendance with around 100 people and ended in violence when protesters attacked a woman, knocking her down and pulling her hair, requiring police escort to remove her from the scene. The event, which called for amnesty for Jair Bolsonaro and support for Flávio Bolsonaro, took place in front of FIESP and did not require traffic closures, despite police presence.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio Bolsonaro, “pai de menina”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, posted a video on social media celebrating the overturning of the veto on the Dosimetry Bill, wearing a Reserva brand t-shirt with the phrase 'father of a daughter'. He has two daughters, Luiza and Carolina. The video was shared in the context of his 2026 presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Lula não vai promulgar PL da dosimetria
item.description: President Lula signaled that he does not intend to promulgate the dosimetry bill, which would reduce sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. He has 48 hours to confirm Congress’s decision, and the expectation at the Planalto Palace is that he will veto the proposal. The issue is tied to political polarization and accountability for the January 8 events.

item.title: Messias deve permanecer no governo depois derrota no STF
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias is expected to remain in the government after his Supreme Court nomination was rejected by the Senate. Although he considered resigning, President Lula signaled he wants to keep him as an ally. A meeting between them is scheduled for May 1, 2026, to determine his future role.

item.title: Lula determina apoio federal para cidades atingidas por chuvas em PE
item.description: President Lula ordered immediate federal support for cities affected by heavy rains in the Recife metropolitan area and Zona da Mata Norte of Pernambuco, including activating the National Civil Defense, mobilizing the National Force of the SUS, and recognizing an emergency situation. At least four people are missing due to landslides, and the government is coordinating with state and local authorities to declare a state of public calamity and mitigate the disaster's impacts.

item.title: Desmoronamento deixa mãe e filha desaparecidas em Pernambuco após chuvas
item.description: A mother and daughter are missing after a house collapsed in the Passarinho neighborhood of Olinda (PE) due to heavy rains in the region. Pernambuco Civil Defense has deployed firefighters for rescue operations, while the Recife Metropolitan Area remains under red alert until Saturday. President Lula has ordered immediate federal support, including activation of the National Civil Defense and the National Health Force.

item.title: O plano perigoso por trás dos ataques de Zema ao STF
item.description: Romeu Zema intensified his attacks on the Supreme Federal Court (STF) as a strategy to gain electoral visibility amid low competitiveness in polls, positioning himself as a 'lone gunman' with a differentiated discourse. While the approach has generated social media engagement, it has not yet improved his polling numbers and carries risks by using satire to address sensitive institutional issues. The confrontation with the STF, particularly regarding the 'fake news inquiry,' has become a fertile ground for candidates seeking to mobilize voters dissatisfied with the Judiciary, though Zema’s strategy remains ineffective so far.

item.title: Chuvas intensas colocam cidades de Pernambuco em alerta
item.description: Heavy rains hit the Recife Metropolitan Area and North Zona da Mata in Pernambuco on Friday, May 1st, 2026, causing floods, river overflows and triggering a red alert from Apac. Goiana recorded the highest rainfall at 209 mm, followed by Abreu e Lima (203 mm) and Paulista (197 mm). Timbaúba declared a state of emergency, affecting 3,500 people, leaving 11 homeless and 52 displaced. President Lula said he spoke with João Campos and Humberto Costa about federal support, but did not mention Governor Raquel Lyra.

item.title: Deputada aciona órgão internacional contra promulgação da dosimetria
item.description: Federal Deputy Luciene Cavalcante (Psol-SP) filed a petition with the IACHR of the OAS to block the promulgation of the 'dosimetry law' after Congress overruled President Lula's veto on Bill 2.162/2023, claiming the law amounts to an amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks and violates international human rights commitments. The petition, co-signed by state deputy Carlos Giannazi and city councilor Celso Giannazi, requests urgent precautionary measures while the commission reviews the case.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o que é o ‘voto de veto’, que assombra as pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections are being shaped by the 'veto vote', where voters choose the least rejected candidate rather than the most preferred. With Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro showing 51% and 49.8% rejection rates respectively, polarization keeps both competitive despite high disapproval, due to loyal bases and lack of viable alternatives perceived by voters.

item.title: Promotores do Pará querem quintuplicar comarcas de difícil acesso para compensar corte de penduricalhos
item.description: Prosecutors from the Public Ministry of Pará request to quintuple the number of judicial districts classified as difficult to access, in order to expand eligibility for a locality-based salary bonus, known as a 'penduricalho'. This move follows an STF ruling that banned the accumulation of supersalaries but left this specific bonus intact, as it was not deemed prohibited. The goal is to offset lost benefits by increasing access to this salary supplement.

item.title: Lula determina apoio federal a autoridades de Pernambuco devido às chuvas fortes em Recife
item.description: President Lula announced immediate federal support for Pernambuco authorities due to heavy rains in the Recife metropolitan area and Zona da Mata Norte, activating National Civil Defense, declaring a state of emergency, and mobilizing the National Health Force. Governor Raquel Lyra confirmed close monitoring, while Apac maintained a red alert. At least 80 people were displaced in Recife and 55 rescued in Cajueiro and Peixinhos, with flooding, landslides, and suspension of the Jaboatão metro line.

item.title: Bolsonaro: cirurgia no ombro termina sem intercorrências, diz boletim médico
item.description: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro underwent arthroscopic rotator cuff surgery on his right shoulder at DF Star Hospital in Brasília, with no complications reported, according to a medical bulletin. He remains hospitalized for pain control and clinical observation after receiving authorization from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes for the full treatment process, including pre-op, surgery, and rehab. The procedure was requested by his legal team following his return to house arrest in March after recovering from aspiration broncopneumonia.

item.title: Boletim médico de Bolsonaro diz que cirurgia ocorreu sem intercorrências
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro underwent shoulder repair surgery at DF Star Hospital with no complications and remains under observation without a discharge date. The procedure was authorized by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, as Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year and three-month sentence under temporary house arrest for leading a coup attempt. Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro accompanied him and reported on social media that he is recovering.

item.title: Em ritmo eleitoral, Hugo Motta convoca maratona de sessões para acelerar PEC 6x1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced a marathon of deliberative sessions to speed up the voting on the PEC ending the 6x1 workweek, leveraging Labor Day symbolism. The move aims to fulfill the procedural requirement of 40 sessions to close the amendment period and is coordinated with the Planalto, following two significant legislative defeats for Lula's government this week.

item.title: 'Vamos trabalhar em uma jornada 7x0 para reeleger Lula', diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, former finance minister and PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, said he will work in a '7x0' schedule to defend and re-elect President Lula in the 2026 elections, emphasizing the need for intense and continuous effort.

item.title: Derrotas no Congresso são derrotas no combate à corrupção, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, stated that the federal government's defeats in Congress represent setbacks in the fight against corruption. He specifically cited the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF and Congress overturning Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetria bill, which he claims benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Liberdade para a opinião antissemita
item.description: The text defends freedom of expression, even for antisemitic opinions, quoting Rosa Luxemburgo and criticizing the Brazilian left for supporting the judicial condemnation of José Maria de Almeida, PSTU leader, for calling for the elimination of Israel. The author states they agree with the German communist revolutionary's view.

item.title: Lula exalta IR, Gás do Povo e menor inflação acumulada no 1º de Maio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva highlighted economic achievements in a national broadcast on the eve of Labor Day, including income tax exemption for those earning up to R$5,000, the 'Gás do Povo' program, the lowest cumulative inflation in four years, low unemployment, and record average income. He announced expanded paternity leave, the end of the 6×1 work schedule (benefiting women especially), R$2 billion in credit for autonomous truckers with lower interest and 12-month grace period, and the removal of fuel taxes in response to Middle East war impacts. The speech was recorded before Jorge Messias’ STF nomination rejection and did not mention the Senate setback or congressional veto overrides.

item.title: Após derrotas de Lula, esquerda retoma ofensiva contra ‘Congresso inimigo do povo’
item.description: Left-wing protesters gathered in São Paulo's Roosevelt Square to oppose the 6×1 work schedule, condemning the National Congress as 'the people's enemy' following legislative defeats for Lula's government, including the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court and the overturning of presidential vetoes on the Dosimetry Bill. Speakers such as Marina Silva, Sônia Guajajara, and Érika Hilton accused Congress of betrayal and called for a broad left front to reelect Lula and elect Fernando Haddad in 2026.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Motta convoca sessões extras da Câmara para acelerar tramitação de PEC
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta has called extra plenary sessions from Monday to Friday to speed up the processing of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, aiming to vote on the text by May 28. The move responds to regulatory pressure from the Lula government's constitutional urgency bill, which would block the agenda if not addressed within 45 days. The special committee, chaired by Alencar Santana and with rapporteur Léo Prates, is expected to issue its report by May 21.

item.title: Filme sobre passagem de Michel Temer pelo Presidência da República será lançado em junho
item.description: The film '963 Days — The Story of a President Who Put Brazil Back on Track', directed by Bruno Barreto and produced by Elsinho Mouco, portrays the political trajectory of former president Michel Temer during his 963 days in office. It will premiere in theaters on June 14 in São Paulo, with a runtime of 1 hour and 40 minutes.

item.title: Em ato no Dia do Trabalhador, Haddad promete ‘jornada 7×0’ para reeleger Lula
item.description: Fernando Haddad promised a '7×0 work jornada' for Lula's re-election during a Workers' Day event, criticizing privatization plans and attacks on workers' rights. He stressed the need to avoid a return to the 'disaster' of the previous government and framed Lula's re-election as crucial for social and economic progress.

item.title: Decisões do Congresso sobre Messias e PL da Dosimetria foram 'derrota no combate à corrupção', diz Haddad
item.description: Former minister Fernando Haddad stated that the Lula government's recent congressional defeats regarding Jorge Messias' STF nomination and the veto override on the Dosimetria bill constitute a defeat in the fight against corruption, citing press analyses suggesting an impunity deal. Speaking at a May 1st event at Força Sindical alongside Marina Silva and Simone Tebet, he lamented the lack of accountability in recent scandals.

item.title: Messias disse a Lula que sairia do governo e presidente pediu para ele ficar; leia bastidor
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias told President Lula he intended to leave the government after his STF nomination was rejected by the Senate. Lula asked him to stay until the end of the term in December, and Messias has not yet made a final decision. The rejection caused tension with senators and STF justices who opposed his appointment.

item.title: Após ter veto derrubado pelo Congresso, Lula não deve promulgar PL da Dosimetria; tarefa caberá a Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula will not promulgate the bill reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, after Congress overrode his veto. The move is symbolic, aiming to avoid having his name associated with the legislation, with promulgation duty falling to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The government plans to use this in the 2026 election campaign, claiming Congress benefited coup plotters, while believing the STF will not intervene.

item.title: PT aproveita 1.º de Maio para lançar campanha e tentar aproximação com motoristas de aplicativo
item.description: The PT launched a social media campaign on May 1st to reach out to app-based drivers, double/triple-shift workers, and small entrepreneurs, advocating for the end of the 6X1 work schedule and a minimum R$10 payment per ride. The initiative aims to overcome historical resistance from these workers to Lula’s government proposals, which have failed to pass sector-specific legislation since 2023.

item.title: Crusoé: Futuro indefinido
item.description: The Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB) celebrated its 60th anniversary on March 24, amid declining national influence and uncertainty about its stance in the 2026 presidential election. Despite having elected three former presidents — José Sarney, Itamar Franco, and Michel Temer — the party has yet to define its position or endorse candidates for 2026. This ambiguity reflects a broader strategic challenge in a fragmented political landscape.

item.title: Partidos com ministérios ajudaram a derrubar veto de Lula à dosimetria
item.description: Seven parties that currently hold or previously held ministries in Lula’s government voted to overturn his veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8 attacks and may benefit Jair Bolsonaro. The PSB, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin’s party, had one deputy and three senators support the override despite its alliance with the PT. The PDT, which leads the Ministry of Social Security, recorded two favorable votes in the Senate and two in the Chamber, maintaining support for Lula’s re-election despite internal tensions.

item.title: Le Senado c’est moi: como Alcolumbre redesenha relação de Poderes ao derrotar Messias
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre imposed the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, aligning with the opposition and delivering a historic defeat to President Lula in a secret vote. The move affirmed his institutional autonomy, signaling that no executive appointment proceeds without his approval and setting a new precedent in inter-branch relations. The action was seen as a strategic positioning ahead of his 2027 reelection bid and a rebuke to Lula for not selecting Rodrigo Pacheco for the vacancy.

item.title: Saiba como votou cada congressista na derrubada do veto à dosimetria
item.description: Congress overrode the presidential veto on the dosimetry bill, reducing penalties for coup-related crimes and benefiting former president Jair Bolsonaro and 849 individuals convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks. In the Chamber, 318 voted against and 144 in favor of maintaining the veto; in the Senate, 49 to 24. The measure now takes effect, to be implemented by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: ‘Melhor presente de aniversário que poderia receber’, diz Flávio sobre veto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 acts, calling it the 'best birthday present' as he turned 45. He said the move marks a new beginning for affected families and honors those unjustly punished, including his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The vote, backed by the Centrão and opposition, followed a procedural move by Congress President Davi Alcolumbre to unbundle the veto.

item.title: Marina: derrota com Messias não foi para o presidente Lula, quem perdeu foi o Brasil
item.description: Marina Silva stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court was not only a defeat for President Lula, but a loss for Brazil as a whole. She emphasized that the decision represents an institutional setback and a threat to judicial independence.

item.title: Crusoé: Eduardo Bolsonaro conecta Trump à rejeição a Messias
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro linked the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF to actions taken by the Donald Trump administration, suggesting a connection between the two. He shared a Washington Times article on his X account to support this argument. The content was first published on O Antagonista under the title 'Crusoé: Eduardo Bolsonaro connects Trump to Messias rejection'.

item.title: Flávio diz que derrubada do veto foi presente de aniversário e honra injustiçados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which occurred on his birthday, calling it a 'gift' and a 'new beginning' for families affected by the January 8 events, including his father, Jair Bolsonaro. He stated the measure honors the unjustly treated and expressed confidence in Brazil's future despite ongoing persecutions.

item.title: ‘Quem perdeu não foi o presidente Lula’, diz Marina sobre derrota de Messias
item.description: Marina Silva stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Federal Court was a defeat for Brazil, not just for President Lula, and defended democracy as a tool for inclusion and social justice. Speaking at a Workers' Day event, she highlighted Lula administration achievements such as leaving the Hunger Map, and supported Haddad’s tax policies targeting the wealthy. She also cited labor struggles like ending the 6x1 work schedule and gender pay equity, and positioned herself and Simone Tebet as potential Senate candidates from São Paulo.

item.title: No Dia do Trabalhador, Lula cita queda no desemprego, ampliação da licença-paternidade e redução do IR
item.description: On Workers' Day, President Lula highlighted reduced unemployment and inflation, income tax exemption for those earning up to R$ 5,000, and a gradual expansion of paternity leave from 5 to 20 days by 2029. He announced a debt renegotiation program with interest capped at 1.99% per month and the use of up to 20% of FGTS balances to pay debts, alongside benefits such as electricity bill exemptions for low-income families and early payment of the 13th salary for retirees.

item.title: Oposição diz que Exército e STF se unem para “silenciar militares”
item.description: The opposition leader, Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), accused Army Commander General Tomás Ribeiro Paiva of adopting a political stance and aligning with the government and the STF to silence conservative military personnel, citing arbitrary transfers and delayed promotions. The accusation came two days after the STF unanimously ruled to make evangelical pastor Silas Malafaia a defendant for injuring the general’s honor, based on statements made in April 2025. Silva claims there is an alliance between the Army’s high command and the Judiciary to intimidate military personnel who uphold values like 'God, Homeland and Family'.
